newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq allows Arabs to acquire Iraqi nationality.
newsitem.headline: Iraq allows Arabs to acquire Iraqi nationality.

text.p: Iraq has introduced a law allowing all Arab nationals -- except Palestinians -- to acquire Iraqi nationality, national newspapers reported on Monday.

"Any Arab except the Palestinian can submit a request to the Interior Ministry to grant him/her the Iraqi nationality," the government newspaper al-Jumhouriya quoted a Revolutionary Command Council decree signed by President Saddam Hussein as saying.
Iraq has banned Palestinians from holding Iraqi nationality long time ago in the hope that they would one day return back to a Palestinian state.
The decree set few conditions for having Iraqi nationality including the applicant should be above the age 18, living in an Arab country and his or her parents should be Arabs.

It added that the interior minister should grant nationality to Arabs who applied for it during a period of three months. It did not say whether they should be living in Iraq or not when they apply for the nationality.
